messages:
Maya (marketing): Heads-up: saw a small but steady stream of leads flagged enrichment:soft_fail from HubSpot during the EU morning (about 12/hr). We need a low-effort guard so SDRs don't miss high-intent contacts.
Priya (ops): Agree. Don't want to flood ops. Suggest: only auto-ticket if retry_count >= 3 AND (hs_lead_score >= 70 OR company_employee_count >= 30). Dedupe by lead_id for 24h.
Ravi (growth): Add a lightweight sales ping for hot ones instead of full ticket: Slack webhook to #sdr-hot with summary + link. Criteria: hs_lead_score >= 85 OR recent_activity >= 4 in last 24h. 10–15m debounce.
Lena (sales): Slack ping is useful. For tickets, include a flag sales_notified true/false and a presigned logs_url. Also skip partner leads (source == 'partner_api') and leads with tag 'no_ticket'.
ingest-bot: notice: enrichment.soft_fail rate increased 210% in last 6h — creating alert A-2026-09 for visibility.
Maya (marketing): Draft HubSpot workflow outline: WHEN enrichment_status == 'soft_fail' AND retry_count >= 3 AND NOT source:partner_api AND (hs_lead_score >=70 OR company_employee_count >=30) THEN POST to /internal/tickets with {lead_id,email,score,last_response_code,logs_presigned_url,tags:["auto-enrich"]}. Also fire sales webhook if score >=85 OR activity>=4 with 15m buffer.
Priya (ops): I'll implement ticket endpoint consumer and dedupe logic. ETA 36h to staging. Also will ensure tickets redact PII and include original_payload_link.
Ravi (growth): We'll add a dashboard: auto-tickets per day, % resolved no-action within 48h, and sales-pings accepted (i.e., converted contact). Use that to tune score thresholds after 72h.
Maya (marketing): Great. I'll write a 1-pager RFC and schedule a 15m rollout sync after staging smoke test. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
